data.rationale: The proposal follows the same flow (From, To, trip type and dates, Search, Continue, Sort & Filter, Apply), but it omits the payment type (cash/points) parameter and step and fixes the sort option to price low to high instead of naming it as a parameter, though a browser automation could still be built from it.
